reason: Final dependency and axiom-contract audit: Work in the H-fixed endomorphism algebra A=End_O(M)^H. Coefficient truncation of the lifted global block is congruent modulo J(A) to the sum c-bar of the lifted H-block idempotents whose block induction is B; centralizer containment defines each induction. Lift this congruence to orthogonal H-fixed idempotents e_corr and e_err with sum 1_M, giving the displayed module splitting. The correspondent idempotent is the sum of the c-hat components, proving the first clause. For the complement, expand the difference between a G-class sum and its H-centralizer part into H-class sums whose class-defect groups do not contain D. These lie in the corresponding relative-trace ideals of A. The primitive summand idempotents of e_err lie in the sum of those ideals; pass to each local corner and use the local-ring ideal argument (Rosenberg's lemma) to put it in one trace ideal. Higman's criterion then makes that summand relatively Q-projective for some Q not containing D, so a minimal vertex cannot contain D. Completeness of O and the preceding lattice Krull-Schmidt theorem justify all idempotent lifts and finite decompositions. AC is inherited exactly from the published block-induction, Higman, block-centre, and defect-support contracts; all new decompositions here are finite. This is Nagao's integral route, not the later character-support conclusion. Evidence inspected: Craven, The Brauer Correspondence, Theorems 2.17–2.18 and §§3.1–3.3, pp. 26–36; Aschbacher–Kessar–Oliver, Fusion Systems in Algebra and Topology, Theorem 5.4 proof, pp. 276–277.
